features.description: Thin Makefile wrapper over cargo (setup, test, style, build, clean), lib.rs re-exports, module skeletons, README shield badges, .gitignore check. Everything else builds on this.
features.name: Project scaffolding

tests.notes: style target passes; cargo build succeeds

features.description: Trait-gated distance metrics so new metrics are one impl. Cosine is the default (embedding workloads); Euclidean kept for SIFT-style benchmarks and general spatial data.
features.name: Distance metrics (trait + cosine + euclidean)
features.notes: Paper is metric-agnostic; default is Cosine per owner preference.

tests.notes: Unit tests: zero-vector guard, known-value pairs, symmetry

features.description: Layered graph storage: per-level neighbor lists with fixed max degree (M / Mmax). No search logic, just storage + bidirectional link helpers.
features.name: Layered graph storage

tests.notes: Unit tests: add node, link symmetry, degree cap enforced

features.description: Single HnswConfig struct (M, ef_construction, ef_search, mL) plus exponential-decay level sampling with seedable RNG for deterministic tests.
features.name: Config + level sampling

tests.notes: Unit tests: seeded RNG deterministic, level distribution decays

features.description: Insert path: greedy descent to target layer, ef_construction beam search per layer, neighbor selection + bidirectional connect with pruning. Depends on F003/F004.
features.name: Insert

tests.notes: Unit tests: single insert, degree caps hold after N inserts

features.description: k-NN search: greedy descent from top layer to layer 1, ef_search beam search at layer 0, return top-k. Depends on F005 (needs a built index).
features.name: Search

subtasks.name: Beam search with ef_search at layer 0

tests.notes: Unit tests: exact match on tiny fixture, k > n handling

features.description: Demo binary (build index, query, print recall) plus end-to-end brute-force recall check: HNSW results must match exact k-NN within tolerance on small fixtures.
features.name: Demo binary + recall test
features.notes: Correctness bar per AGENTS.md; precursor to ann-benchmarks (SIFT-1M euclidean, GloVe cosine).

tests.notes: recall@k within tolerance vs brute force

features.description: Save/load a built index to disk. Explicitly deferred until insert+search+recall (F005-F007) are done.

tests.notes: Round-trip test: search results identical after reload
